gloss: father of Eliphelet, one of David's heroes
definition: אֲחַסְבַּי proper name, masculine father of Eliphelet, one of David's heroes 2Sam 23:34 . (Meaning dubious; 1Chr 11:35 has אוּר׃ , followed by חֵפֶר ; text. probably corrupt.)
